recorder.screenHint: When you press Start, your browser asks which screen, window or tab to share.
recorder.bubbleHelp: Camera bubble: drag it to move, drag the corner to resize, or use the arrow keys and + and -
recorder.countdownHint: Click or press Esc to cancel

errors.camera_denied: The browser did not allow the camera or microphone. Check the permissions and try again.
errors.no_camera: No camera found. Connect one or record your screen only.
errors.device: The camera or microphone could not start. Close other apps that use it and try again.
errors.screen_unsupported: This browser cannot record the screen. Try Chrome, Edge or Firefox on a computer.
errors.screen_denied: Screen sharing was cancelled or blocked.
errors.upload: The recording could not start. Try again.
errors.unsupported: This browser cannot record video. Try Chrome, Edge or Firefox.

recorder.blurNote: Background blur depends on your browser and system, and this one does not offer it for this camera.
recorder.filterNote: This browser cannot apply the low light boost.
recorder.notesPlaceholder: Write what you want to say
recorder.notesHelp: Only you see them, on this page or in the floating window. If you share this window, they appear in the video.
recorder.floatOpen: Controls are in the floating window
recorder.floatOff: Floating controls need Chrome or Edge on a computer.
recorder.drawHelp: Draw or point on the preview above. It goes into the video; it does not follow your mouse on other windows.
recorder.rewindHelp: Removes the last seconds from the video. Press Resume, wait for the notice to end and say it again.
recorder.rewindOff: Going back is not available in this recording: it needs a WebM recording of up to 600 MB.

comments.title: Comments
comments.empty: No comments yet. Leave the first one at the exact second you want.
comments.off: Comments are turned off for this video.

errors.comments_off: Comments are turned off for this video.
errors.name_taken: That name belongs to someone in the workspace. Use another one or sign in.
errors.signin_required: Sign in to comment on this video.
errors.rate_limited: Too many comments on this video right now. Try again in a few minutes.

comments.signinToComment: Sign in to comment on this video.

errors.unauthorized: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.forbidden: Only the person who recorded it or a workspace admin can change this.
errors.invalid_input: Check the fields and try again.
errors.invalid_password: The password needs at least 8 characters.
errors.invalid_cta_url: Use a web address that starts with https:// (no email, phone or IP addresses).
errors.storage_unavailable: Video storage is not configured on this server (BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN).
errors.file_too_large: The video is too large for this server.
errors.upload_failed: The upload failed. Check your connection and try again.
errors.upload_incomplete: Part of the upload is missing. Record again.
errors.ai_disabled: AI is not configured on this workspace, so there is no transcript or summary.
errors.quota_exceeded: This month's AI quota is used up.
errors.rate_limited: Too many AI requests. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.audio_too_large: The audio is too long for the transcription provider.
errors.no_audio: The video has no audio to transcribe.
errors.summary_failed: The summary could not be generated.
errors.part_too_large: An upload part is too large.
errors.invalid_type: That file type is not allowed.
errors.invalid_trim: The end has to be after the start.
errors.trim_needs_cut: The trimmed copy is still missing. Save the trim again.
errors.cut_failed: The trimmed copy could not be made.
errors.processing: The video is being prepared. Try again in a moment.
errors.offline_start: No connection: the recording needs a connection to start.
errors.part_missing: Part of the recording is missing in this browser.
errors.people_needs_personal: "Only specific people" is for videos in My videos.
errors.edit_too_large: Files over 600 MB cannot be edited in the browser.
errors.edit_nothing_left: There would be nothing left of the video. Mark less.
errors.join_incompatible: These two videos cannot be joined: their size or tracks are different.
errors.too_many_recipients: Too many addresses for one send.
errors.recap_failed: The email could not be sent. Try again.
errors.recap_outside: Recaps only go to members of the workspace and people already allowed on this video.
errors.recap_quota: The daily recap limit for this workspace was reached.
errors.allowed_full: A video can have up to 100 allowed emails.
errors.join_mixed_password: These videos have different passwords, so they cannot be joined. Remove one first.
errors.export_widens: Confirm first: more people would read this video.
errors.transfer_owner: The owner's content cannot be transferred.
errors.transfer_not_former: You can only transfer the content of someone who left the workspace.
errors.transfer_self: Choose another person to receive it.

watch.noTranscript: There is no transcript for this video.
watch.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes.

expired.title: This link expired
expired.body: Ask the person who sent it for a new link.

password.title: This video has a password
password.body: Enter the password the sender gave you.

signin.title: Sign in to watch
signin.body: Only some people can watch this video. Sign in to check if you are one of them.

forbidden.title: You can't watch this video
forbidden.body: Whoever shared it limited who can watch it.

not_found.title: This video doesn't exist
not_found.body: It may have been deleted or the link is wrong.

email.title: Enter your email to watch
email.body: The person who shared this video sees the email you enter here.

watch.requestSent: Request sent. You will get an email if it is approved.

library.mineDesc: Videos you recorded. Only you see them in this list; anyone you send the link to can watch, unless you add a password or limit it to the workspace.
library.workspaceDesc: Videos everyone in the workspace can find.
library.emptyBody: Record your screen, your camera or both. When you finish, the link is already copied to share.
library.emptyWorkspaceBody: Move a video here, or record one, so the whole workspace can find it.
library.viewsShort: {n, plural, =0 {No viewers} one {# viewer} other {# viewers}}
library.name: Name
library.deleteFolderBody: The videos inside are kept and go back to the root of this space.
library.deleteBody: The video, its comments and views are deleted, and the link stops working.
library.moveHelp: Videos in the workspace are visible to everyone in it.
library.moveNeedsPrivacy: This video is set to "Only specific people", which only works in My videos. Change who can see it in Share first, then move it.
library.moveBecomesPeople: In My videos this video changes to "Only specific people", so the rest of the workspace stops seeing it.
library.laterDesc: Videos you saved for later. Only you see this list.
library.archiveDesc: Archived videos are out of your lists. Their links keep working.
library.spaceDesc: {n, plural, one {# member} other {# members}}. Only members and workspace admins see this space.
library.spaceMembersHelp: Members see the videos in this space. Removing someone cuts their access right away, unless the video is open to anyone with the link.
library.deleteSpaceBody: Its videos go back to "My videos" of whoever recorded them. Its folders are deleted. No video is deleted.
library.emptyArchiveBody: Archive a video from its menu to take it out of your lists without deleting it.
library.emptyLaterBody: Open the menu of any video and choose "Watch later".
library.emptySpaceBody: Record a video here, or move one from its menu.
library.noTagMatches: No videos here have that tag.

record.title: Record a video
record.desc: Screen, camera or both. It uploads while you record.
record.noTranscription: Transcription and AI summary are off on this server: the video is recorded and shared all the same.
record.statusOffline: Offline: saving in this browser ({mb} MB pending)
record.savingOffline: No connection. The recording is safe in this browser and uploads by itself when you are back online.
record.replyNote: When you finish, this video is posted as a reply. It has its own link and follows the privacy of your new videos.

share.title: Share
share.workspaceOnly: Only signed-in members of this workspace
share.notify: Notify me when someone watches or comments
share.passwordHelp: At least 8 characters. With a password, downloads start turned off.
share.downloadNote: Turning it off removes the download button. The video still streams, so a determined viewer could capture it.
share.peopleNeedsPersonal: "Only specific people" is for videos in My videos. In a shared space its members can see it.
share.peopleHelp: They need to sign in with that email. One per line or separated by commas. Removing an email cuts access right away. Nothing is sent: copy the link and share it.
share.requireEmail: Ask for an email to watch
share.requireEmailHelp: For people who are not signed in. The email is not verified.
share.rotateHelp: The current link and embeds stop working.
share.rotateBody: Anyone with the current link or an embed loses access. You will need to share the new link.

detail.createdCopied: Video ready. The link is copied.
detail.frameFailed: This frame could not be captured. Try another browser.
detail.aiOff: AI is not configured on this workspace, so there is no transcript or summary (ai_disabled).
detail.chaptersHelp: One per line, like "0:00 Intro". The first starts at 0:00 and each lasts at least 5 seconds.
detail.noSpeech: No speech was found in the audio.
detail.noViews: No one has watched it yet. Your own views don't count.
detail.trimHelp: Cut the start and the end. The original is kept (full length {length}) and you can undo it.
detail.ctaHelp: A button on the video that opens a web page.
detail.thumbnailHelp: Pause the video on the frame you want and use it as the thumbnail.
detail.name: Name
detail.deleteBody: The video, its comments and views are deleted, and the link stops working.
detail.trimInverted: The end has to be after the start.
detail.cutFailed: The trimmed copy could not be made. Try again.
detail.trimNoteWebm: When you save, a trimmed copy is made without re-encoding and that is what everyone else gets: the player, the shared page, the embed and the captions. The cut snaps to the keyframe before the start, so up to about 2 seconds before the start stay in their file (the player does not show them). The thumbnail and the GIF are made again from the start of the trim.
detail.trimNoteOther: This file type cannot be cut in the browser: viewers see the trimmed video, but the file they stream still has the trimmed parts. The thumbnail and the GIF are made again from the start of the trim.
detail.retentionLabel: {start}% of viewers saw the start and {end}% the end
detail.regenerating: Making the thumbnail and the GIF from the trim…

pending.title: Recordings waiting to upload
pending.body: These recordings stayed in this browser because the upload did not finish. Resume the upload, download them or discard them.
pending.error: The upload could not finish. Try again when you have a connection.

signout.title: {n, plural, one {You have # recording that has not uploaded} other {You have # recordings that have not uploaded}}
signout.body: They are saved only in this browser. If you sign out now they are deleted from here.

overlays.title: Text, boxes and arrows
overlays.help: Shown by the player while the video plays, also on the shared page and in embeds. Downloaded files do not include them.
overlays.urlHelp: Web links only. It opens in a new tab when someone clicks it on the video.

edit.title: Edit from the transcript
edit.help: Check the phrases to remove. It creates a new video in My videos and keeps this one as it is. It copies the transcript and chapters and does not use AI.
edit.onlyWebm: Editing from the transcript and joining only work with WebM recordings. Uploaded MP4 and MOV files can only be trimmed.
edit.noTranscript: This video has no transcript yet.
edit.markSilences: Mark silences of 2 s or more
edit.precision: Cuts are not re-encoded, so each one ends at the next keyframe: up to about 2 s more of what follows can go. The summary is not copied. Filler marks only catch phrases made up entirely of filler words.
edit.joinHelp: Creates a new video with this one followed by the other. Both need the same size and tracks (a recording with microphone and one without cannot be joined).
edit.joinEmpty: You have no other videos to join.
edit.working: Working on it, {pct}%. Keep this tab open.
edit.failed: The copy could not be created.

export.title: Use it elsewhere
export.help: Creates a page or an issue with the link, summary, chapters and transcript that you can see. The text is copied as it is, without rewriting it with AI.
export.recapHelp: Only to members of the workspace and people already allowed on this video, up to {max} addresses per send and 50 per day (10 for new accounts). People outside the workspace get a fixed text with the link.
export.recapPrivate: This video is not open to anyone with the link: recipients need access to watch it.
export.recapSend: {n, plural, =0 {Send} one {Send to # person} other {Send to # people}}
export.recapSent: {n, plural, one {Sent to # person.} other {Sent to # people.}}
export.recapDuplicate: This same recap already went to these people. Nothing was sent.
export.widenDoc: This video is more closed than Docs. The new page copies its summary and transcript, and members who can open Docs pages will read them even if they cannot watch the video.
export.widenIssue: This video is more closed than the project. The new issue copies its summary and transcript, and everyone who sees the project will read them even if they cannot watch the video.

settings.readOnly: An admin of the workspace can change these settings.
settings.defaultsHelp: They apply to new videos. Existing videos stay as they are.
settings.brandHelp: Your name, logo and color on /v pages and embeds, for people who can watch the video.
settings.logoNone: No logo. PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 1 MB.
settings.retentionHelp: Deletes videos older than the period you choose, with their comments and analytics. Off by default. The first deletions run {days} days after you turn it on or shorten it. Authors get a notice in the app at the start of those days and when their videos are deleted.
settings.retentionOn: First deletions from {date}. Deleted so far: {deleted}.
settings.retentionConfirmBody: {count, plural, =0 {No video will be over that age at the first deletion.} one {# video will be over that age at the first deletion.} other {# videos will be over that age at the first deletion.}} Deletions start in {grace} days and cannot be undone. Their authors get a notice now.
settings.transferHelp: Moves the videos and folders of someone who left the workspace to another person, including their personal videos. It cannot be used on the owner or on anyone still in the workspace.
settings.transferOwner: {name} ({videos, plural, one {# video} other {# videos}}, {folders, plural, one {# folder} other {# folders}})
settings.transferDone: Transferred {videos, plural, one {# video} other {# videos}} and {folders, plural, one {# folder} other {# folders}}.
settings.transferConfirmBody: {videos, plural, one {# video} other {# videos}} and {folders, plural, one {# folder} other {# folders}} go from {from} to {to}. {to} will also see the personal videos of {from}.
settings.transferNone: Nobody who left has videos or folders here.

tags.label: Tags
tags.help: Enter or comma adds it. Tags help you filter the library and find videos with Cmd+K.
tags.limit: A video can have up to {n} tags.

captions.title: Captions
captions.help: How captions look on this video, in the app, on the shared page and in embeds. Downloaded files do not carry them.
captions.translationsHelp: Viewers pick the language from the player, next to CC. Each translation uses the AI quota of the workspace.
captions.needTranscript: Translations need a transcript. When this video has one, you can translate it here.
captions.limit: A video can have up to {n} translations.

errors.too_many_caption_tracks: This video already has the maximum number of translations.
errors.no_transcript: This video has no transcript yet.
errors.transcript_too_long: This transcript is too long to translate.
errors.ai_disabled: AI is off for this workspace.

admin.noTop: No views you can list in this period.
admin.privateNote: Counts include everyone's personal videos. Titles only appear for videos you can open.
admin.activityHelp: Who changed sharing, retention or content. Video titles are not shown here.

actions.share_change: changed who can watch a video
actions.export_doc: turned a video into a Docs page
actions.export_issue: turned a video into a Track issue
actions.captions_translate: translated the captions of a video
